description:
One simple reel idea that brings real morning customers. No fancy gear, low cost, clear wording you can copy.
Use this exact combo, caption and filming checklist to test for a week. Adjust price, limit or hours for your neighbourhood.

scenes.doodle_prompt: barista behind counter, empty cafe chairs, small wall clock

scenes.narration: Run an Early Bird Combo: coffee plus pastry for $5, limited to first 20 customers who say this Reel.
Make a 15-second Reel: close-up steam, pastry pull-apart, barista smile. Keep it raw, handheld, bright morning light.
scenes.doodle_prompt: phone filming coffee and pastry on a small table, smiling barista nearby

scenes.narration: Copy this caption: "First 20 say this Reel and get combo $5. Weekdays 7–9am. No app needed."
scenes.visual_query: barista handing cup to smiling customer

scenes.narration: Spend $5 to promote the Reel to people within 3 miles for one day. Target coffee lovers and nearby commuters.
